CREATE TABLE active_matches (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	provider_match_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	league_id VARCHAR(100), 
	league_name VARCHAR(200), 
	season VARCHAR(32), 
	home_team VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	away_team VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	start_time TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	venue VARCHAR(200), 
	round VARCHAR(80), 
	country VARCHAR(100), 
	sport VARCHAR(80), 
	last_updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_active_matches PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_active_matches_provider UNIQUE (provider, provider_match_id)
)

CREATE TABLE archive_jobs (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	archive_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	dataset_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	league VARCHAR(120), 
	r2_key VARCHAR(600) NOT NULL, 
	row_count BIGINT, 
	file_size_bytes BIGINT, 
	checksum VARCHAR(128), 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	verified_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	deleted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_archive_jobs PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_archive_jobs_r2_key UNIQUE (r2_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_archive_jobs_valid_archive_status CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'UPLOADING', 'UPLOADED', 'VERIFIED', 'FAILED', 'DELETED'))
)

CREATE TABLE bookmakers (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	provider_bookmaker_id VARCHAR(160), 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	country VARCHAR(100), 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_bookmakers PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_bookmakers_provider UNIQUE (provider, name)
)

CREATE TABLE coupons (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	total_odds NUMERIC(12, 4) NOT NULL, 
	confidence NUMERIC(6, 5) NOT NULL, 
	paper_stake NUMERIC(12, 4) NOT NULL, 
	paper_profit NUMERIC(12, 4), 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	settled_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_coupons PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE daily_metrics (
	date DATE NOT NULL, 
	total_matches INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	analyzed_matches INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	predictions INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	predictions_pending INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	wins INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	losses INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	hit_rate NUMERIC(6, 5), 
	coupons INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	coupon_wins INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	coupon_losses INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	paper_pl NUMERIC(12, 4), 
	paper_stake NUMERIC(12, 4), 
	r2_bytes BIGINT, 
	postgres_bytes BIGINT, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_daily_metrics PRIMARY KEY (date)
)

CREATE TABLE historical_ingest_days (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	season VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	league_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	ingest_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_attempt_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	records_seen BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	records_archived BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	records_failed BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	failed_match_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(80), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_historical_ingest_days PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_historical_ingest_days_provider UNIQUE (provider, season, league_id, ingest_date)
)

CREATE TABLE job_runs (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	job_type VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	finished_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	duration_ms BIGINT, 
	records_seen BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	records_written BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	records_skipped BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	records_failed BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	records_processed BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(80), 
	error_message VARCHAR(240), 
	error VARCHAR(240), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_job_runs PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_runs_valid_job_status CHECK (status IN ('RUNNING', 'SUCCESS', 'PARTIAL', 'SKIPPED', 'FAILED')), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_job_runs_idempotency_key UNIQUE (idempotency_key)
)

CREATE TABLE lessons (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	date DATE NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	summary TEXT NOT NULL, 
	recommendation TEXT NOT NULL, 
	confidence NUMERIC(6, 5) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_r2_key VARCHAR(600), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_lessons PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE notification_deliveries (
	fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	sent_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_notification_deliveries PRIMARY KEY (fingerprint)
)

CREATE TABLE system_settings (
	key VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	value JSONB NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_system_settings PRIMARY KEY (key)
)

CREATE TABLE users (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_users PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE active_odds (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	match_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	provider_odds_id VARCHAR(160), 
	provider_market_id VARCHAR(160), 
	provider_bookmaker_id VARCHAR(160), 
	bookmaker_entity_id UUID, 
	bookmaker VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	market VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	selection VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	line NUMERIC(8, 3), 
	raw_line VARCHAR(80), 
	line_key VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	odds NUMERIC(10, 4) NOT NULL, 
	captured_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	period VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_active_odds PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_active_odds_bookmaker_entity_id_bookmakers FOREIGN KEY(bookmaker_entity_id) REFERENCES bookmakers (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_active_odds_match_id_active_matches FOREIGN KEY(match_id) REFERENCES active_matches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_active_odds_snapshot_natural UNIQUE (match_id, bookmaker, market, selection, line_key, captured_at)
)

CREATE TABLE match_results (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	match_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	provider_result_id VARCHAR(160), 
	home_score INTEGER, 
	away_score INTEGER, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	finished_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	result_source VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	verified_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_match_results PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_match_results_match_id_active_matches FOREIGN KEY(match_id) REFERENCES active_matches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_match_results_match_id UNIQUE (match_id)
)

CREATE TABLE predictions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	match_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	market VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	selection VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	probability NUMERIC(6, 5) NOT NULL, 
	confidence NUMERIC(6, 5) NOT NULL, 
	value_score NUMERIC(8, 5) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	model_version VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	decimal_odds NUMERIC(10, 4), 
	paper_stake NUMERIC(12, 4) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	paper_return NUMERIC(12, 4), 
	settled_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_predictions PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_predictions_match_id_active_matches FOREIGN KEY(match_id) REFERENCES active_matches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_predictions_match_id UNIQUE (match_id, market, selection, model_version)
)

CREATE TABLE coupon_items (
	coupon_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	match_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	market VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	selection VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	odds NUMERIC(10, 4) NOT NULL, 
	prediction_id UUID, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	settled_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_coupon_items PRIMARY KEY (coupon_id, match_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_coupon_items_match_id_active_matches FOREIGN KEY(match_id) REFERENCES active_matches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_coupon_items_prediction_id_predictions FOREIGN KEY(prediction_id) REFERENCES predictions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_coupon_items_coupon_id_coupons FOREIGN KEY(coupon_id) REFERENCES coupons (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
